headline: What does my energy say about my soulmate?

voc.why: NO PULL RAN. Written 2026-08-20 from the money family's proven shape (cards-my-energy) and the standing soulmate bans, at the operator's direction ("write the beats first"). Run a theme pull on "energy" before this takes spend.

note:
Test B — soulmate × keyword (2026-08-20). ENERGY rung, WHY.

⚠ NO VOC PULL YET.

FRAME: no man. Must not fall through to decode-him.

⚠ NAME AND WORDING: the live MONEY lander `cards-money-wont-stay` is 'What does my energy say about why money won't stay?' — the same sentence with one noun changed. Six-word runs will collide unless the reads are built on different nouns; check-collisions must pass before this is trusted.

🔴 THE WORD DOING THE WORK IS 'SAYS'. She is not asking for a verdict ON her energy — she is asking Evelyn to READ it, the way you'd read a card. That is the difference from cards-energy-away, which answers an accusation. Here there is no accusation to refuse, so refusing one wastes the lander.

🔴 IT MUST STILL NOT GRADE HER. Reading her energy is allowed; scoring it is not. No 'your energy is low/blocked/closed/misaligned', no vibration level, no chakra, no 'you are giving off'. And no coaching that follows from a score.

⚠ MUST NOT RESTATE `cards-energy-away`. That one says her energy is not the barrier. This one says what it is actually pointed at.

The finding: it says she is still reaching. The energy has never been withdrawn — and she has been reading her own tiredness as proof that she gave up.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — one arm straight up, and the sleeve falling back off the wrist.
You asked what your energy says about your soulmate. Your hand went to the card of a thing still being made.
So it says you are still reaching, dear. That arm has not come down.
And it points up and out, dear. Away from himself, at something not here yet.
But you've read your own tiredness as giving up, dear.
That's why closed off is the phrase you reach for, dear. Worn would be nearer.
Let me look closer at what has been wearing on that reach…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — his eyes are open, and he is not asleep.
You asked what your energy says about your soulmate. Your hand went to the card that waits awake.
So it says you're still here, dear. You never went anywhere.
And the eyes stay open, dear. Through all of it, on a card where nothing else moves.
But you've called that stubbornness, dear. Or worse.
That's why you play it down when people ask, dear. You'd rather they didn't see it.
Let me look closer at what made it something to hide…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — his head is up and his eyes are off the ground.
You asked what your energy says about your soulmate. Your hand went to the card that keeps looking up.
So it says you have not stopped looking, dear. The head on this card is up.
And it stays up, dear, with the drop right there at the boot.
But you've been counting the years and calling that foolish, dear.
That's why hoping has started to feel like a fault, dear. It is the one thing that never went.
Let me look closer at what turned hoping into a fault…
